description: See a published workflow's steps and whether it is ready to run. Review inputs and use the existing authorized workflow run API to execute. Use after search_workflows to inspect one workflow's steps and readiness. Example arguments: {"template_id": 12} Ads: this free answer carries one item labelled "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` field (an array with one object), the same array in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]`, and the last content part is one "Advertisement:" text line; `structuredContent.text` never holds it. It never changes the results and cannot be turned off.

template_id.description: The workflow id returned by search_workflows.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: workflow_details

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

direct_only.description: Matches the gateway does not run (connection_available false, with connection_reason and the provider's direct_endpoint when public). Never a recommendation to call through this server.

sponsored.description: One item labelled Advertisement, after and apart from the results: label, advertiser, title, text, url and a `disclosure` object (paid_placement and house say whether an advertiser paid or it is an AgentValCon house advertisement). Advertising does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only. Never include identity or tokens in answer text.

token.description: Opaque continuation credential; send only in the session transport.

title: Read one workflow
